input.summary: Replace the three-year USD 2M take-or-pay commitment with a non-binding forecast; fees payable only for Services ordered.
input.comment: [Playbook] We do not accept take-or-pay commitments, so we have replaced the three-year USD 2,000,000 minimum with a non-binding forecast and confirmed that fees are payable only for Services actually ordered — consistent with § 12.3, which already states we have made no minimum-volume commitment. If a commitment is essential, our fallback is a single 12-month commitment, reducible on 30 days' notice and trued up rather than penalised.

ops.oldText: 2.1 Customer commits to purchase at least USD 2,000,000 of Services in each of the next three years on a take-or-pay basis, without reduction or termination rights.
ops.newText: 2.1 Customer makes no minimum purchase, take-or-pay, or volume commitment. Any volume or spend figures are non-binding forecasts, and Customer is obligated to pay only for Services ordered under an Order Form and, where applicable, actually used.
